description: Combined PRD evidence from two isolated Codex/Ralph stream worktrees. Verification and PR gate run on this integration branch.

userStories.title: Reject invalid Vertex time-series windows
userStories.iWant: the window aggregation endpoint to reject zero-length or inverted time windows before querying storage
userStories.soThat: bad OSv2-style time-series requests fail fast with a clear 400 instead of doing undefined or expensive backend work

acceptanceCriteria.given: a configured Vertex time-series HTTP handler
acceptanceCriteria.when: GET /api/v2/ontologies/{ontology}/objects/{objectType}/{primaryKey}/timeseries/{property} is called with to equal to or before from
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is HTTP 400 with errorName InvalidTimeWindow and the querier is not invoked

acceptanceCriteria.given: a configured Vertex time-series HTTP handler
acceptanceCriteria.when: the request supplies a strictly forward from/to window
acceptanceCriteria.then: the handler continues to call the querier and returns the existing bucketed series response

userStories.title: Aggregation Results Export CSV
userStories.description: Operators using the browser aggregation page can download the current aggregation result buckets as CSV instead of manually copying table cells.
bddAcceptanceCriteria: Given /aggregation/:ontology/:objectType has returned grouped aggregation buckets, when the operator clicks Export CSV, then a CSV download is created with group columns followed by metric columns.
Given CSV cells contain commas, quotes, nulls, or nested values, when the CSV is generated, then values are escaped using RFC4180-style quoting and stable stringification.
Given an aggregation response has no buckets, when the results panel renders, then the export affordance is not shown.
verification: Frontend BDD regression test for the export button and generated CSV content.

userStories.title: Aggregation Chart Type Switcher
userStories.description: Operators can switch aggregation visualizations between bar, line, and pie modes rather than being locked to a bar chart.
bddAcceptanceCriteria: Given grouped aggregation data exists, when the operator switches chart type, then the selected chart renderer updates without losing the result table.
Given no grouped data exists, when the results render, then chart controls remain hidden.

userStories.title: ObjectSet Diff CSV Export
userStories.description: Operators comparing saved ObjectSets can export the diff sections to CSV for review and handoff.
bddAcceptanceCriteria: Given a computed ObjectSet diff with only-in-A, only-in-B, and changed rows, when the operator exports CSV, then the file contains section and row metadata.
Given no diff has been computed, when the page renders, then export remains disabled or hidden.
